stem_md: $x=\phi(t),y=f(t)$（$\phi^\prime(t)\ne0,f^\prime(t)\ne0$），下列微分公式不正确的是哪一个？
analysis_md:
解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=\phi'(t)，\frac{dy}{dt}=f'(t)，\text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}$$

即 $dy=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}dx，\quad dy=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}dx=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}d\phi(t)=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}\phi'(t)dt=f'(t)dt$

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=\phi'(t)，\frac{dy}{dt}=f'(t)，\text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}$$

即 $dy=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}dx，\quad dy=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}dx=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}d\phi(t)=\frac{f'(t)}{\phi'(t)}\phi'(t)dt=f'(t)dt$
